name: Penwood Manufacturing LLC
old_description: We’ve been serving contractors, designers, and design-build firms as a wholesale partner throughout the United States since 1999, building and delivering custom cabinetry and architectural millwork that is designed to perform beautifully for decades.
about:
Penwood Manufacturing LLC, an Amish custom cabinet shop, was founded in 1999 in Fresno, Ohio. The company began as a wholesale partner serving contractors, designers, and design-build firms across the United States with custom cabinetry and architectural millwork.

The shop produces custom cabinetry and architectural millwork, handling complex projects that exceed the capabilities of many standard cabinet shops, including creative built-ins and architect-driven solutions. Their finishing process involves hand-applied stain that is sprayed on and then hand-rubbed with cloth to carry color into every corner and molding detail, followed by premium conversion paint or clear finish applied with a handheld sprayer. Operations run from two Ohio facilities: the main shop in Fresno and a panel facility in Baltic.

Penwood serves contractors, designers, design-build firms, and cabinet dealers nationwide. Client references include The Cabinet Co. in Hilliard, Ohio; Ferguson Builders LLC in Greenville, South Carolina; Heitmeyer Building & Design in Pickerington, Ohio; and Charleston Amish Furniture in Charleston, South Carolina.

The company emphasizes old-fashioned reliability and intentional excellence, positioning itself as a partner for complex custom work that does not exist in standard cabinetry catalogs.
